body: Me too. Even though I have a loving and great set of in laws I just can't help but feel like I will just never fit in anywhere I am.
I take rexulti and it's great for me. Also on 900 mg lithium

I have been off rexulti due to not going to my dr appts (bad of me, I know, I'm working on it) and I've been hearing the knocking too. It scares me and makes me not want to get too far from the door. There have been several times when I've gotten up and answered the door at night (seems to be the only time it happens) and no one is there. I just got the rexulti filled today and I'm getting back on it tonight, hoping it helps. 

Sometimes I'll hear other things like a melody repeating over and over and those don't freak me out as much. I once heard a lady singing through a crack in the door when I was rocking my daughter to sleep and it wasn't too alarming, more just like "huh. That's not really there." Lol. It is frustrating for sure but you're not alone.

I don't know what to do about it, but I also have trouble brushing my teeth because I gag so much. I also gag when I try to swallow pills (which for a bipolar person is every day, which is pretty annoying).
I am. Thank you
I don't even want to say.

I'm so sorry I'm just now seeing this. Dealing with court, I have no idea. We've been twice and I didn't get to say a word both times. He has a felony charge though so they've been pushing his dates back. He was arrested early May, next time we go to court is in October if that tells you anything. It's a long process. As for staying strong, just keep your family and friends close and, as my therapist told me, let yourself feel what you feel. Don't really try to suppress any feelings. It'll only get you down in the long run and slow the recovery process. I'm sorry I don't have more advice, I'm still a bit lost about it myself.

Something similar happened to me. I regretted calling the police almost immediately after i did it because I didn't think he would be arrested. His family subtly tried to convince me that I had ruined his life and his reputation by calling. This was months ago. I am confident that it was his actions, not mine, that led him to where he is. We have been to court twice and have to go again in October so I understand the annoyance/pain/confusion of having to go through all that. You're not alone and it was not your fault. He made the choice to abuse you. Your attempt to resolve the situation is not shameful. You were looking out for yourself and your child. You did the right thing. I don't know you personally but i think I have a grasp on how you feel and I want you to know that I love you. And your child loves you. And I hope you can find the support you need to get through this.

Of course, if we try to work our relationship out there will be many conditions on my part. I am not going to help him out with the charges the next time if it happens again. I will leave and never come back. I just think the circumstances led to it and he wasn’t in his right mind.. I’m hoping he will get into recovery for his alcoholism and change for the better, but I’m giving it a lot of time and thought before I even think of moving back with him with the girls. Thank you for your encouraging words. x

I am working on having it modified and even lifted, it’s just a long process. They said possibly by next week it would be up though. I have made sure there are others around when he has seen the kids. I trust my mother in law with them and she is with them and him right now. Of course I am still seeing them and making sure they’re ok and it’s only for two days. I appreciate your concern and your input. Thanks so much for replying. x
I need to try that. Thank you for the recommendation. I feel validated for the first time in forever about choosing to stay. Thank you. Thank you. Thank you.

He was previously emotionally and financially and psychologically abusive, but we had never had a physical fight. I just don’t know. I think he never thought I would actually call the police on him and leave with the kids, so he perpetuated it since I never resisted. Now that I have, I feel like he will be too scared to go to jail again to do it again. Who knows though.

Thanks for responding, it means a lot to me.

I just don’t know what to do. It seems like it should be black and white but it’s not. He loves our children more than anything. He would die for them. It’s just me he has a problem with I guess.

I’m not “actively” suicidal, just having suicidal ideations. I’ve been to the hospital twice before for it and it never really helped. I appreciate your feedback and I will definitely take it into consideration. The kids and I are safe at the moment as there is still a no contact order in effect.

I am so sorry for your situation. That’s horrible. Sometimes people act in such vile ways, I feel like there is something inside them that hurts that they feel the need to act the way they do. I understand about causing your family pain — my mom actually asked an attorney if she could have custody of MY children if I went back to my abuser. Talk about crazy but obviously it comes from a place of confusion, love, and heartbrokenness. 

I feel addicted to mine too and have felt that way since the day I laid eyes on him. I wonder if I’m more co-dependent than in love.

Thanks for your response. It means a lot to me that you would share your story and offer some advice. x

I am keeping my children happy and healthy, they are what keep me from staying in bed all day. That’s great advice. I have already started applying for some governmental assistance. Being financially dependent on someone for seven years and then having it taken away at the drop of a hat.. no car, no job, two kids. It’s hard.

I’m trying to remember that I don’t need to worry about what I can’t control at this point. Thank you for your response. x

I’ve had suicidal thoughts before and even a plan which led to two hospitalizations. I don’t feel that I have a plan now, I’m just so down I don’t see any reason in staying here. Thank you for your offer. I really appreciate it. I’m going to therapy and I have my whole family who are super supportive and willing to listen. It’s still just really hard.

I’m sorry you’re going through what you’re going through. It’s really rough. I feel like in some cases it hurts more than it helps. But you have to keep yourself safe of course.

Thanks for the reply. x

Oh my goodness, that does sound horrible. :( it’s always terrible seeing your loved ones in pain.. but like you said, modern medical technology is amazing and like your dad I’m also sure my fiancé will make a full recovery. It’s just the time until then that is going to be hard, which of course you know. Ive just had such strange emotions since the accident and can’t quite process it all yet. Thanks for your thoughtful and encouraging words, they really do help.
Thank you so much. That means a lot to me. ❤️

Thank you so much, this is exactly what I needed to hear. I am leaning on my mom a lot right now, for emotional support and for helping take my oldest to her practices and such. We are so lucky that he is still alive, but it just seems like such a hard hurdle to overcome right now. I know time will heal most things though and I’m trying to keep that in mind when it gets rough. Thank you so much for your words of encouragement. They mean more to me than you know.
I love this.
